move_to_object_storage:
Move to object storage
(should be lower than total retention period)
object_storage_stores: S3, GCS, MinIO or another S3-compatible store
object_storage_note: Data older than the move period is stored in the bucket and stays queryable. The first query on cold data takes about a second; repeats are close to local. Backups of the local disk don't include cold data.
object_storage_missing: No object storage disk is configured, so data stays on the local disk.
